python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,sys,stat,re,json,tempfile,subprocess,urllib.parse,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
if root.name!='GateApp-Bot':print('STK04_OWNER_ROOT_INVALID');sys.exit(80)
image='localhost/gace-stk04-pin:88fb602c'
if subprocess.run(['podman','image','exists',image],capture_output=True).returncode:
 print('STK04_IMAGE_NOT_BUILT');sys.exit(81)
token_re=re.compile(r'^[0-9]{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}$')
tokens=[];dburls=[]
def add(k,v):
 v=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
 if k=='BOT_TOKEN' and token_re.fullmatch(v):tokens.append(v)
 if k in ('DATABASE_URL','GAYBBS_DATABASE_URL','POSTGRES_URL'):
  p=urllib.parse.urlsplit(v)
  if p.scheme in ('postgres','postgresql') and p.hostname and p.path:dburls.append(v)
add('BOT_TOKEN',os.environ.get('BOT_TOKEN',''))
add('DATABASE_URL',os.environ.get('DATABASE_URL',''))
for folder in (root/'deploy',root/'deploy'/'secrets'):
 if not folder.is_dir():continue
 for f in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
  if not f.is_file() or f.is_symlink() or f.stat().st_size>32768:continue
  name=f.name.lower()
  if any(x in name for x in ('userbot','session','auth','phone','oauth')):continue
  if not ('.env' in name or 'gaybbs' in name or 'bot' in name or 'database' in name or 'postgres' in name):continue
  st=f.stat()
  if st.st_mode & 0o077:continue
  try:s=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
  except (OSError,UnicodeError):continue
  if token_re.fullmatch(s):tokens.append(s);continue
  if s.startswith(('postgresql://','postgres://')):add('DATABASE_URL',s);continue
  for line in s.splitlines():
   if not line or line.lstrip().startswith('#') or '=' not in line:continue
   k,v=line.split('=',1);add(k.strip(),v)
tokens=list(dict.fromkeys(tokens))
dburls=list(dict.fromkeys(dburls))
if not tokens:print('STK04_GROUP_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE_IN_OWNER_CONFIG');sys.exit(82)
def me(token):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/getMe',timeout=12) as response:
   j=json.load(response)
  return j.get('result') if j.get('ok') is True else None
 except Exception:return None
owners=[t for t in tokens if (me(t) or {}).get('username','').lower()=='gaybbs_bot']
if len(owners)!=1:print('STK04_GROUP_IDENTITY_NOT_UNIQUE_OR_UNAVAILABLE');sys.exit(83)
if len(dburls)!=1:print('STK04_DATABASE_NOT_ADMITTED_OR_AMBIGUOUS');sys.exit(84)
print('STK04_GROUP_IDENTITY=VERIFIED')
print('STK04_DATABASE_CONFIG=IDENTIFIED')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gace-stk04-live-') as d:
 folder=Path(d)
 tf=folder/'token'
 tf.write_text(owners[0],encoding='utf-8');tf.chmod(0o600)
 ef=folder/'env'
 ef.write_text('BOT_TOKEN_FILE=/run/secrets/gaybbs_pin_token\nDATABASE_URL='+dburls[0]+'\n',encoding='utf-8');ef.chmod(0o600)
 cmd=['podman','run','--rm','--network','host','--user','0','--read-only',
  '--pids-limit','64','--memory','256m','--security-opt','no-new-privileges',
  '--env-file',str(ef),'--volume',str(tf)+':/run/secrets/gaybbs_pin_token:ro',
  image,'node','/app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs']
 try:r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  print('STK04_PIN_RESULT_UNKNOWN_AFTER_TIMEOUT');sys.exit(85)
 for line in (r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr).splitlines():
  if line.startswith(('STICKER_PIN_OWNER=','STICKER_PIN_TARGET=',
   'STICKER_PIN_TARGET_SOURCE=','STICKER_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=',
   'STICKER_PIN_MESSAGE_ID=','STICKER_PIN_INDEPENDENT_READBACK=',
   'STICKER_PIN_RESULT=','STICKER_PIN_ERROR=')):
   print(line)
 if r.returncode:print('STK04_PIN_OPERATION_FAILED');sys.exit(86)
 if 'STICKER_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=YES' not in r.stdout:
  print('STK04_PIN_UNCONFIRMED');sys.exit(87)
 print('STK04_TOPIC_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=PASS')
